subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Hexadecimal: Compact Binary Shorthand
description: A quick, practical guide to Hexadecimal: Compact Binary Shorthand.

hook.text: Writing long binary strings is tedious. Hexadecimal packs four bits into one symbol.

buildup.text: Hex uses 0-9 and A-F. The hex digit 'F' represents binary 1111, which is decimal 15.

discovery.text: The binary number 11111111 becomes FF in hex. Much easier to read and type.

twist.text: Web colors use hex: #FF0000 is red, #00FF00 is green, #0000FF is blue.

climax.text: Memory addresses, MAC addresses, and error codes are all written in hex for readability.

punchline.text: Hex turns eight messy bits into two clean characters — readability wins.

quiz.question: What binary value does the hex digit 'A' represent?
